name: Fundamental property
description: Fundamental material properties are always present: density for portions of matter, mass and volume for objects. Fundamental object properties are extensive, scaling with the size of the object, and are given a value through a scalar value specification carrying a numeric value and a unit label.
competency_questions: Which properties does a material entity always bear regardless of circumstance? Which fundamental properties belong to the portion of matter and which to the object? What numeric value and unit specify a given fundamental property?
